Anika: FYI onboarding capella-lite-13b (llama->qwen conversion) flaked on a few lexicon/spacing cases after GPTQ q4_0. Minimal repro attached.

Anika: Quick repro:
```bash
python convert.py --from llama --to qwen --in ckpt/ --out capella.pt
python quantize.py --input capella.pt --scheme q4_0 --out capella.q4
python run_local.py --model capella.q4 --prompt \"Who invented the telephone?\" --max-tokens 12 --dump-logits
```
Observed: occasional glued tokens (no separating space) and truncated punctuation. Example output: \"AlexanderGrahamBell.\" instead of \"Alexander Graham Bell.\"

Leo: Can you paste the dumped logits and a tokenized sequence (ids -> strings)? Also `--dump-kv` would help to see KV offsets.

Anika: Paste snippet: 
``nlogit_delta_mean: 0.0118
logit_delta_top1: 0.39
example_ids: [225, 88, 1023, 17]
example_tokens: [\"Alexander\", \"Graham\", \"Bell\", \".\"]
q4_output_tokens: [\"AlexanderGraham\", \"Bell\", \".\"]
```

Priya: That looks like tokenizer normalization/merge issues + position indexing. Did the conversion insert a leading BOS or sentinel that's being skipped by the KV indexing path? If pos ids are off, rotary angles shift and some attention heads end up permuting tokens.

Sam: Another hypothesis: qwen-variant uses per-head rotary frequencies (shape (heads, dim)) while our convert+quant pipeline collapsed `rotary_freq` into a 1D tensor. Quantization can collapse dims when parameters are broadcastable. Check tensor shapes before/after quantize: `rotary_freq.shape` expected (32, 64) but quantized produced (2048,) or similar.

Anika: I inspected the on-disk metadata: pre-quant `rotary_freq` shape: [32,64]; post-quant meta incorrectly lists shape [2048]. So conversion flattened the axis.

Leo: Oof. That would definitely change phase per head. Two remediation paths: 1) fix converter to preserve shape; 2) runtime fallback to reconstruct `rotary_freq` from inv_freq and reshape into per-head layout. Option 2 is quick for triage.

Priya: Also add a tokenizer sanity pass: check for duplicate byte-sequence mappings and ensure NFC normalization is applied consistently. If duplicate byte sequences exist, raise conversion error. We had a similar issue earlier with a renamed sentinel.

Sam: For triage I implemented a tiny runtime shim: when a mismatch between expected head dim and rotary tensor rank is detected, rebuild rotary from `inv_freq` using the model's num_heads/head_dim. Local run: fixed token spacing and aligned logits within 1e-2 relative to FP16 baseline on small prompts. Perf hit ~ +2ms per token.

Anika: Ran the full lexicon smoke (eval-bot): 6/432 failing -> down from 18/432. Failures now narrow to some diacritic cases and long-context sentinel insertion.

eval-bot: regression/lexicon-suite for capella-lite (q4_0) completed  result: partial pass, 6/432 failures. Report: https://internal/reports/1778887777

ci-bot: quant job #6371 done for capella-lite-13b (q4_0). Artifact: s3://redwood-quant/capella-lite/6371/capella.q4

Leo: Good progress. Next steps: Anika raise WIP PR with runtime fallback + unit test against a small reference (include tokenization checks). Priya add tokenizer-normalization gate in converter. Sam sweep q3_k and q5_0 on small shards to see behavior variance; include `--quant-checksums` to detect param layout changes.

Anika: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/9751 (WIP). Contains `rotary_rebuild_fallback` and test `tests/test_rotary_rebuild.py`. Tagging @Leo @Priya for review.

Priya: I'll add `normalize_unicode=NFC` to the converter and a check for duplicate byte sequences. If duplicates found, fail conversion early with a clear message pointing to `tokenizer.normalize()` step.

Sam: I'll kick q3_k / q5_0 on a 1% shard overnight and collect `--quant-checksums` and `--param-layout` diffs. If q3_k preserves headwise shapes we can prefer it until converter fix lands.

Leo: Assigning owners: Anika (PR + regen artifacts), Priya (tokenizer guard), Sam (quant shard experiments). I'll draft a short incident note if customer-facing endpoints use capella-lite.

Anika: Thanks all  will update PR and post regression link once green. :coffee:
